text:
mika: Heads up — release pipeline stuck on staging-canary job, failing the post-build integration step. Blocking the cut.

deploy-bot: Canary promotion paused for run 2026-06-12T10:15Z — artifact fetch error from registry (504). Auto-retry enabled x3.

ci-bot: integration-tests (staging-canary) failed: 7 tests failed, exit 1. Relevant snippet:
```
E  test_user_sync.py::test_sync_large_dataset
AssertionError: expected 0 failures, got 1
Error: checksum mismatch downloading artifact
expected: abc123def456
actual:   def456abc789
```

katie: looks like a checksum mismatch from the artifact mirror, not a unit test flake. Could be a multipart upload race or cache corruption on the region mirror.

zane: If mirror is flaky we can either pin to last-good image digest or revert the PR that bumped the dependency. Which is faster for a cut? Change window ends at 15:00 UTC.

ops_jen: Reverting the PR will require a full rebuild (30-40m). Pinning to previous digest and manually promoting should be quicker if we trust the previous artifact.

mika: Agree — prefer pin+promote to avoid rebuild. We need an explicit signal in the release notes and a follow-up to investigate mirror integrity.

katie: I can confirm the last-good digest: sha256:4f8b9c2eae7f. Command to pin in deploy config:
```
image: registry.redwood-inference/prod/service@sha256:4f8b9c2eae7f
```

zane: I'll run the manual promote after we update the canary target. Will also watch the canary smoke suite.

deploy-bot: Manual promote blocked while canary hold is active. Run id=20260612-1007. To clear hold use `/deploybot clear-hold 20260612-1007` once CI green.

mika: OK — plan:
- katie will update canary image ref to pinned digest and push a patch to deploy-config (patch created: #release/patch-pin-1719975310)
- zane will trigger re-run of staging-canary after patch lands and clear hold when smoke passes
- ops_jen will stand by to revert if pin fails
- we will delay cut by up to 2 hours (change window allows) and update release notes

katie: patch pushed and tagged `release/patch-pin-1719975310`. CI triggered for the new deploy-config change.

ci-bot: retriggered pipeline for run 20260612-1012 (deploy-config pin). Tests queued.

mika: I'll draft the release note blurb now — short: "Release delayed due to artifact mirror inconsistency; canary pinned to last-known-good image sha256:4f8b9c2eae7f. Postmortem to follow."

zane: staging-canary smoke green ✅ — I cleared the hold and kicked off manual promote. Watching logs.

deploy-bot: Manual promote started for run 20260612-1012. Canary promotion proceeding.

mika: Thanks all. Follow-ups: create ticket for mirror integrity and multipart-upload retries, and schedule postmortem if we see recurrence. Will update product on the 2-hour delay and append to release notes.

ops_jen: filing ticket now: INF-4872 "artifact mirror checksum drift on multipart uploads". Assigning to infra-mirroring team.

mika: Closing thread — monitor for any regressions. :thumbsup:
